subtitle: Environmental Design for Architecture II
keywords: Architecture/Urban GX 2.Carbon neutral 3.Building eqipments 4.Primary energy consumption 5.Energy conservation building
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) learn about architecture/urban GX. (2) learn about energy conservation buildings. (3) learn how to realize carbon neutrality in buildings and cities.
advice: In this course, students learn about architecture and urban GX, actual conditions of energy conservation buildings and zero energy buildings. 1. Concept of architecture and urban GX. 2. Features of energy conservation buildings. 3. Environmetal design for carbon neutrality in architecture and cities.
requiredKnowledge: Students should have taken Environmental Design for Architecture I.
